propositions: The target-side guard in _same_level_neighbors (_is_at_level call) must refuse cross-level edges; a direct edge from epic-B to task-M must not be traversed when checking for cycles at the epic level.
A multi-hop path (epic-A → task-M → epic-B) must not reconnect same-level nodes through lower-level intermediates, even when the current-side guard permits node expansion.
When a blocker ticket has an unreducible dir and a tombstone with a non-terminal status, the loader must create a status-only stub that reflects the recorded status verbatim.
A tombstone status must override a reduced status when both exist, so an open blocker dir paired with a {status: deleted} tombstone counts as closed and unblocks dependents.
A malformed (unparseable) tombstone must degrade to deleted status rather than be treated as absent, so an open blocker paired with corrupt tombstone bytes still counts as closed.
